claim: TransferDesk.jsx was modified to add watchlist functionality
The file compiles without errors
TransferDesk.jsx was rendered in jsdom
The main interaction paths were clicked through in jsdom
The implementation has not been tested in a real browser
Nothing has been committed to git yet
Stars are displayed next to the player name on transfer cards
Small stars are displayed after the from-club and to-club on transfer cards
Free agent entries do not receive a star
Multiple clubs entries do not receive a star
A star is displayed next to the club heading on story cards
Small stars are displayed after each candidate name and candidate club on story cards
Small stars are faded by default and revealed on hover
On touch screens small stars remain faded but can still be tapped
A Starred toggle button is added next to the search box
The Starred toggle button displays a count of how many stars the user has
The Starred toggle button turns the starred filter on or off
The Starred filter works in combination with the league filter
The Starred filter works in combination with the search filter
Tab counts update to reflect the Starred filter state
When nothing is starred, the empty view explains how to add stars
Stars are saved as names rather than IDs
Starring a name matches that name across both transfer cards and story cards
A transfer card is shown when its player, from-club, or to-club is starred
A story is shown when its club is starred
A story is shown when any candidate or candidate's club is starred
Starring Chelsea causes Barcelona's story to appear because João Pedro (Chelsea) is a candidate in it
Matching stories are shown in full with the starred names filled in
The watchlist is saved to localStorage under the key td-watchlist-v1
The watchlist is stored in the format { players: [], clubs: [] }
If the saved value is broken the app starts with an empty watchlist instead of crashing
If localStorage is unavailable the app starts with an empty watchlist instead of crashing
Open tabs are kept in sync with each other via localStorage
The Starred filter state is not saved to localStorage and always defaults to off on load
A saved list with one bad entry loaded as {players: [Éderson], clubs: []}
With the Starred filter on, only Éderson's transfer card and Man United's story were shown
After starring Chelsea from a card, the board showed 5 Chelsea-related transfers plus Éderson
After starring Chelsea, the stories shown were Man United, Real Madrid, and Barcelona
After starring Chelsea, localStorage updated to reflect the new star
Removing every star emptied the saved list in localStorage
Removing every star caused the empty-watchlist message to appear in both views
The Napoli & Milan story is stored under the exact name 'Napoli & Milan' and does not match a star on 'AC Milan' or 'Napoli' separately
If the live feed spells a player name differently from the stored star (e.g. Ederson without accent vs Éderson with accent), the entry will not match
